names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 9442, «Александр (Поздеевский), иерей, сщмч.», with the office and the rank word left off. The day line gives the forename and the grade only, «Александра пресвитера».

death.note: The year the calendar's day line prints after his name: «Сщмч. Александра пресвитера (1940)».

feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia. One row per church is the schema, so the January day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 12 октября ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Александра пресвитера (1940).»
source.note: No rank is read onto him. Both of the day's icons are the plain service and both stand in its first paragraph; his line is in the third and carries none.

attestations.note: «Сщмч.» marks a hieromartyr, a priest killed for the faith; «пресвитер» on the day line and «иерей» on the index page are both the simple priesthood, below the archpriest. Nothing else is printed on either page: no birth, no diocese, no parish, no charge, no place of death.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's 25 octombrie was not read (2026-10-04); the Romanian calendar does not generally keep the Russian new martyrs of the Soviet period.
Not checked: saint.gr/10/25 was not read for him (2026-10-04).
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs's Prologue page for civil 25 October 2026 was not read (2026-10-04).
